title: Dot product of the restricted frequency
statement: Let $H$ be a subspace of the binary cube $\bbr_2^n$, with a binary subspace split identifying that cube linearly with $H$ times a complementary binary cube. For every vector $\eta$ in the original cube and every complementary vector $a$, the dot product of the frequency obtained by restricting $\eta$ to the complementary factor with $a$ equals the dot product of $\eta$ with the image of $(0,a)$ under the splitting isomorphism.
hypotheses_covered: A subspace $H$ of the binary cube of dimension $n$
A vector $\eta$ in the binary cube of dimension $n$
A vector $a$ in the complementary binary cube
